name: Dusty room (integration, 100 ticks)
expected: Each dust detection while in FwdNormal starts a 3-tick clean_up; dust during a power-up does not extend it; dust on a later tick after it ends starts a new one.
Dust detected while turning or reversing, or on the tick a turn/reverse ends, causes no clean_up.
A front obstacle during clean_up cancels it (clean_off, then clean_on after the turn).
Avoidance follows left-first; reverse when boxed in.
Dust cells passed with clean_off stay on the map.
function_text: EF-12 – Dust: power-up (clean_up) for 3 ticks, then back to clean_on
EF-13 – Dust during an active power-up does not restart it; dust after the end starts a new one
EF-14 – An obstacle during power-up cancels the power-up
EF-15 – Dust ignored while turning/reversing and on the tick a turn/reverse ends
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-07 – Avoidance: turn right when the left is blocked
EF-10 – Boxed in (F, L, R): move backward for at least 3 ticks, continue while both sides are blocked
